system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: instructions="You are a careful repo assistant. Use your tools to answer from the code."
system_prompt_style.note: Agent declares fixed instructions string supplied by developer; no rendering mechanism visible in evidence.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: attach ready-made toolkits (files, git, shell) or any MCP server

observation_format.evidence_quote: executes the calls, and feeds results back to the model

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: pass OpenAI-format JSON tool specs — aisuite returns the model's tool-call requests

tool_count.note: Tool set is developer-supplied; no fixed default count in evidence.

tool_schema_source.evidence_quote: aisuite generates the schemas from signatures and docstrings
tool_schema_source.note: auto_generated default; hand-written OpenAI JSON specs also accepted; MCP servers supported.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: aisuite sends your message, executes any tool calls the model requests, returns the results to the model, and repeats until the conversation completes

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: run multi-turn loops, attach toolkits and MCP servers, and govern execution with policies
planning_granularity.note: OpenWorker ships platform/coworker/tools/plan.py and todo.py, suggesting explicit plan objects in the desktop app.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: declare an `Agent` once and run it with the `Runner`

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: declare an agent once, run it with a `Runner`, and attach **toolkits**
delegation_mechanism.note: platform/coworker/tools/subagent.py in file tree suggests opt-in subagent_spawn in OpenWorker.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: **Tool policies** — `RequireApprovalPolicy`, allow/deny lists, or your own callable deciding which tool calls run.
human_in_loop.note: OpenWorker: risky actions ask for approval first.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: `response.choices[0].intermediate_messages` carries the full tool interaction history

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: **State stores** — persist and resume runs (in-memory, file, or Postgres) and continue conversations across processes.
long_term_memory.note: OpenWorker also ships platform/coworker/memory/sqlite_store.py and skills/.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: **State stores** — persist runs and resume them across processes: `InMemoryStateStore`, `FileStateStore`, or `PostgresStateStore` with `thread_id`.

self_verification.evidence_quote: **Artifacts & tracing** — capture what an agent produced and every step it took along the way.
self_verification.note: No verifier/critic component listed in the Agents API pieces.

rollback.evidence_quote: attach ready-made toolkits (files, git, shell) or any MCP server, and govern it all with tool policies
rollback.note: No undo/rollback mechanism named in the evidence.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: max_turns=2 # Maximum number of back-and-forth tool calls

cost_controls.evidence_quote: aisuite routes the call to the right provider with the right parameters
cost_controls.note: platform/coworker/providers/router.py present; no token budget or caching in evidence.

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Your API keys, your conversations, and your files stay on your machine.
execution_isolation.note: Shell toolkit runs locally on the user's machine; described as sandboxed toolkits but no container evidence.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: Grant access to a folder (read-only or read-write) and ask in plain language.
filesystem_access.note: Toolkits take root="."; OpenWorker gates writes outside granted folders.

network_policy.evidence_quote: search the web for news about my industry and write a one-page brief to my briefings folder

permission_model.note: Allow/deny lists and approval policies also selectable; platform/coworker/risk.py present.

tracing.evidence_quote: **Tracing** — every `RunResult` carries its steps, raw responses, and a `trace_id`; plug in trace sinks for observability.

replayability.evidence_quote: persist and resume runs (in-memory, file, or Postgres) and continue conversations across processes

eval_hooks.note: No benchmark/evaluation runner in the file tree.

target_domain.evidence_quote: give models real Python functions as tools, run multi-turn loops, attach ready-made toolkits (files, git, shell) or any MCP server
target_domain.note: OpenWorker targets everyday desktop/office tasks (other); git/files toolkits and aisuite-code-cli cover swe.
